faqs.question: How long does it take to launch our business website?
faqs.answer: Most custom business websites are delivered and live in 4 to 6 business days. Complex custom web applications or ERPs take 8 to 14 days.

faqs.question: Is domain, hosting, and SSL included?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every website package includes free high-speed Cloudflare edge hosting, TLS 1.3 encryption SSL, and seamless domain configuration.

faqs.question: Can I update phone numbers, photos, and prices myself?
faqs.answer: Yes! With our dedicated Admin Panel at /admin, you can change phone numbers, logos, WhatsApp messages, promo banners, and projects with one click.

faqs.question: Will my website rank on Google for local Tamil Nadu searches?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every website is built with Schema JSON markup, fast OpenGraph tags, semantic HTML5, and registered with Google Search Console.
